name: Quabbin Open 2016
information: All proceeds from this competition will be used to supply the Quabbin Music Department with instruments to lend to students.  Additionally, there will be an instrument drive during registration.  If you have any used instruments sitting around, and would like to donate, please indicate so in the additional comments section of registration.  It would be greatly appreciated.  As a gift for the donation, anyone who donates an instrument will receive a 3x3 supplied by Cube Depot.
